notes.title: Minor EULA Update
notes.notes:
We have just released a minor update for [i]Richie's Plank Experience[/i] which includes the following:
- Updated Safety message text
- Updated EULA text
- Reduced HMD removal threshold from 5s to 1s to trigger safety message

notes.title: End of Year update. Have a great time!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Turned on Santa Simulator bell in the elevator.
[*] Updated Santa simulator with shinier bell and shooting star VFX. 
[*] Updated safety message. Now requires agreement from each user. 
[*] Removed rope until we can figure out why it's glitching out. 
[*] LIV sdk should be updated. 
[*] Fixed bug where users sometimes don't have gravity when stepping off the plank. 
[*] Removed ability for users to accidentally press the elevator buttons when standing outside the elevator. 
[*] Change to skybrush particles. 
[/list]

notes.title: Dignity Update
notes.notes:
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Added subtle steam to the air conditioning vent near the plank. This is a small detail, but we think it's the little things that matter. This will help sell the feeling that there's working gravity in the experience.
[*] Added a DIGNITY billboard. A few months ago, during a team meeting, we decided that Dignity would be our company initiative. We believe the world will be a happier place if we all remember to use it. 
[*] Reverted the post processing to a more realistic option in a previous update.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where oculus headsets couldn't set the width of the plank.
[*] Fixed the low music volume
[/list]

notes.title: Nightmare Update + Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Today is the day we say goodbye to the Clowns. They’ve given us plenty of scares over the years and we wish them all the best as they move on to chase their dreams as kid party entertainers. Good luck Clowns! 

In this update we have streamlined the Nightmare mode. It’s now more impactful allowing you to move through the experience at a better pace. Ultimately, this will make it easier for you to share with friends and family. 

Other improvements include:

- A ton of bug-squashing, including better feet tracking, 
- Graphical improvements to fires on Fire Deck, 
- Graphical improvements to Santa Simulator, 
- New caution sign in the elevator,
- Bug fix for falling through the floor on the way up the elevator.

We hope you enjoy the update. We would love to see your reactions - join us on [url=https://discord.gg/aSG5QZe]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Mixed Reality Update + 31 other minor fixes/changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/543f107911c632360e0e3f8c954c97dfd2179d09.png[/img]Lots of small improvements and bug fixes this week. 

[H1]IMPROVEMENTS[/H1]
[list]
[*]Added Mixcast SDK! This makes it much easier to film mixed reality videos, with or without a green screen.
[*]Removed some redundant objects / models for slight FPS boost. 
[*]Improved spatial audio for 4 different Nightmare sounds. The breathing dentist adds a lot! Nightmare is activated with 666 on the number panel.
[*]Changed billboards. "THE MORE I THINK ABOUT IT, THE BIGGER IT GETS" is graffiti found in our home town, Brisbane Australia.
[/list]

[H1]BUG FIXES[/H1]
[list]
[*]Fixed falling bug if plank is raised too high.
[*]Stopped 666 from working if user isn't looking at numbers.
[*]Turned off forced AA for Oculus.
[*]Fixed shoe model. (this is why controller was disappearing in feet tracking mode)
[*]Fixed bug with phone ringing too much after the fall in nightmare mdoe.
[*]Fixed elevator sound if using warp to ground whilst elevator was moving.
[*]Bug fixes with skybrush pallet. Color selection works better now.
[/list]

[H1]MINOR IMPROVEMENTS[/H1]
[list]
[*]Game now saves which object you added to end of the plank and will add it for every user until you select "none" again.
[*]Reduced brightness of leaf falling particle.
[*]Reduced opacity of dust particles.
[*]Put fog levels back to where it was.
[*]Made the rocket glow with a little more red.
[*]Improved smooth snap turning for Oculus touch
[*]Slightly shortened length of logo scene of nightmare.
[*]"I'm Short" button is now higher.
[*]Added Korean Translation. 
[*]Updated Oculus SDK.
[*]Fixed dirt in nightmare mode.
[*]Increased volume of city traffic.
[*]Fixed Pro Builder errors.
[*]Lowered Donuts, Rockets and cake when added to the plank
[*]You can now add rockets to the end of the plank for easy flying. This should improve the user flow when you want players to walk the 
[*]We now sell custom versions of Richie's Plank to help your event or product launch party.
[*]Added shortcuts 1,2,3,4,6 for shortcuts to add objects on plank.
[*]Added ability to add custom objects to VR Menu -> Bonus options.
[/list]

[H1]COMING SOON[/H1]
[list]
[*]Umbrella mode. Umbrella added to the end of the plank to float slowly around the city.
[*]Space Y rocket launch
[/list]

notes.title: The Grand Opening Update
notes.notes:
This is Toni and Richard from Richie's Plank Experience. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/3eebdec868663886349e06ecc4e6c297d65e4d8f.jpg[/img]


Below you'll see details of a rebuilt city, feet tracking, nightmare mode and a few other surprises that came out today. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BsJ6zqLYc_Q]Announcement video here[/url]							 (8min) 

If you have any questions, we're here to answer them for you.

[h1]REBUILT CITY[/h1]

The city has now been rebuilt from the ground up. Textures, buildings, rooftops, interiors, sky, roads, the plank, elevator. Pretty much everything has been rebuilt. We admit, the early versions looked pretty bad.
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/4d4b65405b36f914f7dcf4c9f347b020a44437fc.jpg][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/26xixJkJgQjxmooXm/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

Old Version
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/67c63f423ddc2d5c8e2c77fafa2d164b1af659d0.jpg[/img]

New Version
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/4d4b65405b36f914f7dcf4c9f347b020a44437fc.jpg[/img]
New Version from the Ground
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/46f1d8ded10b82cc90edf6bd27791a89e169161f.jpg[/img]

[h1]FEET TRACKING[/h1]


Here's how it works:
[b]Vive Controllers[/b]
Using a rubber band, attach the controller upside down, with the head of the controller on the outside of your shoe. This works pretty well, straight out of the box. Attach additional rubber bands if it's not tight enough. Please note that flying and other levels won't work since you obviously won't be able to use your hands. Feet tracking enables hands free mode.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/2c2c4a942b3b72266420cc7c6c8a2db489925648.jpg[/img]

[b]Vive Tracking Pucks[/b]
Great for arcades and serious VR demo fans. Screw the tracker onto some immitation Crocs (or real crocs) for a universally fitting shoe. Purchase the screw from a hardware store. You'll need to dampen harsh vibration with some rubber bands. This stop the shoe from glitching slightly. Please note, the latest update is still being uploaded to the Vivestore.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/4e0044df1aaadd92ecf87e38c2fa12d8440727ca.jpg[/img]

[b]Oculus[/b]
You'll need two rubber bands for each controller. Both individually looped onto the wrist strap. Then, run them under the shoe and finally use the touch controllers' "circle of lights" to hook the rubber bands. See announcement video for details. We noticed that with most Oculus setups, camera's can't see the ground. Please promise you won't attempt this if your Oculus cameras can't fully see the ground. You'll be setting yourself up for frustration, otherwise. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/272b60840dfffcab1817db17d7b1538826bf3a89.jpg[/img]


[h1]NIGHTMARE MODE[/h1]

Press 666 into the number panel in the elevator to enable Nightmare mode.  Hope you enjoy the surprise! We'll be improving this over time. Not suitable for children.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fITVggScnn7f1Sg/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]FLYING IS MORE FUN[/h1]

Faster sounds. Tuned Rockets. Note: If you enable Ludicrous Speed mode in settings, you can easily die if you hit something at high speed. Pressing code 112 on the number panel will automatically give you rockets.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT0xeKwbWBnc89HrIQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/0637c5cd528ffb09fb2a4c99f7fdd73e4ad61992.jpg[/img]

[h1]SKYBRUSH COMPETITION[/h1]

To celebrate coming out of early access, we're hosting a competition. Win a $50 Steam voucher and naming rights to a Building in Richie's Plank Experience. Post a photo or video of your skybrush art to Steam, Twitter or Instagram with #SkyBrush hashtag. Winner picked December 31st. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT0xexfiJOQOF0xiXm/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW GAME[/h1]

Yes, we're working on a new game. All we can say for now is that it'll involve flying and a super hero academy. ETA 2019.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/2da1fd5e821fef2d9f19965c6035861c5400ec1d.jpg[/img]

[h1]UPDATED SANTA SIMULATOR[/h1]

It's that time of year to say Merry Christmas!
It looks better and works more smoothly. There's also an option in settings to have the sleigh automatically center itself to the center of your play space. It does this when you first enter the sleigh. Required for smaller play spaces. HO HO HO! My best score is 59 presents delivered. Can you be a better Santa?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxfjLsE2NkNmbjhK/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]OUT OF EARLY ACCESS[/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us while in early access! We hope you enjoy this update. The early access price will finish when this post is 48 hours old, so if you've been sitting on the fence, consider buying it now. We will strive to keep bringing you bug fixes, improvements and a SPACE Y launch late next year.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/930b38df121c6521b23b8c45551f5ff2c3657d3f.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:

Today's update includes:

New HD building on the ground floor. Across the street from starting location.

Headset fades to black if you try to cheat and peek through the elevator doors.

Terrain texture is now complete. It looks WAY better when flying through the mountains. Be sure to enable 3d terrain in the graphics settings.

Higher res realistic lighting.

Improved skybox.

A default externalcamera.cfg for making mixed reality videos.

Santa Sleigh is nearly repaired. (enable in Game Features Menu)

Darker clouds.

notes.title: 6 month celebration update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149028/d404135a334ef124639d67ece3daddbdad561911.jpg[/img][h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
[list]
[*]New light raytrace light baking

[*]New static car

[*]Car shadows

[*]Better frame rate

[*]Better street lights with light emission.

[*]New aggressive rocket  models and particle effects. Faster looking and better frame rate.

[*]2 New buildings.

[*]New fire particles! Better looking and better frame rate.

[*]Improved bloom effect.

[*]PBR Plank Textures. Much more realistic looking.

[*]Improved Elevator lighting.

[*]Improved some concrete textures.

[*]Road has cracks, puddles and detail.

[*]Improved textures on close air con vents. One has a subtle drip. Drip. Drip.

[*]Fog now has a slight blue haze. More realistic than the orange.

[*]Elevator shaft now has subtle ripples in it. Really accentuates the feeling of speed as you fall past it.

[*]Occasionaly, leaves fall from the trees.

[*]Tree animations added.

[*]More subtle lights around the main city square.

[*]Player shadow is back.

[*]Car shadows are fixed.

[*]Bloom with forward rendering and AA now works.
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]"Fine Tune Mode" for Vive has been supercharged.
[*]Oculus Touch support!
[*]Easier VR plank setup. This is now the default setup option for Oculus. 
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed minor VR menu bugs.

[*]VR Menu pointer now works more reliably. It doesn't get blocked by elevator or pot plants.

[*]Elevator buttons are now more reliable.

[*]USABILITY: The color pallet for skybrush now works with less bugs.
[/list]


[H1]KNOWN ISSUES[/H1]
[list]
[*]Frame is a bit slow when flying sometimes.
[*]Need better instructions for which buttons open menu and use hose / rocket
[*]Santa Sleigh too slow and clips with air con vent sometimes.

notes.title: Christmas is Over Update
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few issues and removes the christmas button&bell. If you still want to ride in that sleigh, there's an option to enable it again in Game Settings.

Fixes and improvements in this update:

GRAPHICS
Trees are now animated.
Lighting and shadows have been re-baked.

GAME PLAY
[list]
[*]Removed santa simulator as default (re-enable in Game Settings)
[*]You can now disable falling off the plank in Game Settings.
[*]All settings now save and reload when you restart.
[/list]

KNOWN BUGS TO BE FIXED IN NEXT UPDATE
[list]
[*]Fire alarm plays too long after leaving fire deck.
[*]Performance is lacking when flying around in the main square. 
[*]Ground has too many cracks in it. Need to fix them.
[*]Some of the buttons sometimes stop working, requiring a restart. Having trouble replicating this.
[*]Some of the cars are overlapping. 
[*]Some of the clouds and trees leaves face the camera plane, not camera position.
[*]The Fire Rocket enemy is too red and its thrust is off alignment.
[*]The VR menu won't work if window is not in focus.
[*]Elevator buttons won't press while user is pulling the trigger.
[*]Conversion from cm to inch is wrong in plank setup UI.
[/list]Music from death plays too long.
